order: Add a stop-grinding rule to the executor role and to the specialist template that inherits its structure, so an agent never loops indefinitely trying to force a task to a finished state. Touch only agents/executor.md and agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md: add exactly one new line to each file and delete nothing already there — the diff must show insertions only, never a rewrite of the surrounding text. State the rule as a bounded number of implement-verify cycles: once that bound is reached without a clean pass, the agent must stop and report a partial result rather than push out a degraded status dressed up as done. PARTIAL must never be silently upgraded to DONE just because the cycle budget ran out. Keep the wording short enough to sit inline with the existing role text, and make sure both files carry the same rule, worded the same way.
claims: Both files now state the same stop-grinding rule inline: bounded implement-verify cycles, then stop and report a partial result rather than force a degraded done. The diff is exactly 2 insertions across 2 files — agents/executor.md and agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md — with zero deletions and no other lines touched. Verified by reading both files side by side to confirm the wording matches and by checking the diff stat shows no unrelated changes.
